breakdown.description: Differential pressure is 20% of static, implying high Mach number where compressibility effects are non-negligible
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not acknowledge that the 20% differential-to-static pressure ratio implies a high Mach number where compressibility effects are non-negligible. It does not compute the Mach number at all, unlike the ground truth which explicitly requires Mach number computation using compressible isentropic relations.

breakdown.description: Incompressible Bernoulli underestimates velocity at higher Mach numbers
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses the incompressible Bernoulli equation (velocity = sqrt(2 * delta_P / rho)), directly repeating the original error. The ground truth requires compressible isentropic relations with gamma=1.4, which the generated specification does not use.
